'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Joe Olson LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).<ref name="pdf">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D3.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 11, 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008205435/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The list is a typed sheet headed "Joe Olson Worlds Day 3 LS", with hand corrections, rather than the standard deck sheet. Page 12 also starts his Dark list. Where the sheet does not identify a card version, the entry is left unlinked as written.

== Deck info ==

* '''Side:''' Light
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
